title: Decide typed boundary for semi-structured SRD strings
description:
Finding source:
- Fable P4 observation: some regular semi-structured strings still require consumer parsing, including weapon properties like "Ammunition (range 150/600)" and "Versatile (1d10)", plus creature savingThrows/skills/senses strings.
- Fable marked these as regular and parseable, but the audit policy requires explicit closure.

Acceptance criteria:
- Inventory semi-structured fields still requiring consumer parsing.
- Decide which remain strings, which need typed projections, and which should have shared parser/accessor helpers.
- Create implementation beads for any fields deterministic tools should not parse ad hoc.
- Document accepted non-issue decisions.
notes: 2026-07-08 ADR 0017 adjustment: Use the compiler decision procedure for each semi-structured string family. Repeated regular forms should become structural parsers/shared accessors; irregular reviewed families may become source-grounded curated specs; remaining contextual cases need model-adjudicated-supported evidence. Deterministic tools should not parse ad hoc strings when the pack can expose a typed semantic substrate.
close_reason: ADR 0019 and reproducible 787-path inventory committed; no pack data changed
